raw_response:
Strong liquidity (current ratio 2.29) and a solid equity base ($18.9B vs. $27.4B liabilities) support credit quality, but profitability is only moderate relative to the large asset base (EBIT of $811M on $58.2B assets) and leverage is still meaningful. On balance, the figures fit a lower-medium investment-grade profile rather than a stronger A-category issuer.

DECISION: BBB
